key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1070
name: format_unsigned_nibble_string
description: Takes the low four bits of the unsigned input repeatedly, maps each through a digit lookup table, and writes the characters into the buffer. It then reverses them into reading order and adds a terminating zero, returning the character count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:109C
name: format_signed_decimal_string
description: Writes a minus sign first when the value is negative, then repeatedly obtains a decimal digit and stores it as an ASCII character. It reverses the collected characters into order, adds a terminating zero, and returns the number of characters written.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:10D4
name: parse_signed_decimal
description: Skips an optional leading plus or minus sign, accumulates the decimal digits that follow into an integer, and negates it for a minus sign. It stores the result through the output pointer and returns the number of characters consumed.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1120
name: append_byte_to_buffer
description: Increments a byte counter held in a global context block, stores the byte argument at the current write pointer, and advances that pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:113A
name: format_into_buffer
description: Clears a written-character counter, stores the destination buffer pointer, and runs the formatting routine with the byte-append routine as its output callback. It then writes a terminating zero at the end of the buffer and returns the counter.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1174
name: return_block_to_free_list
description: Rounds the requested size up to a minimum aligned size and inserts the block into a free list kept in address order, merging it with adjacent free blocks. It updates the free-byte total and returns an error when the block overlaps one already in the list.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:126C
name: delete_file_and_record_error
description: Calls the DOS delete-file routine through the library pointer. When the call fails it reads the error code from the DOS library, stores it in a global error field, sets a status value, and returns a failure result; on success it returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:129C
name: lookup_entry_and_call_handler
description: Looks up an entry with the first routine and returns a failure result if none is found. Otherwise it calls the second routine with the entry's stored pointer and the remaining arguments, and returns a failure result if the global error flag is set.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:12E4
name: copy_memory_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from source to destination. When the source is at or below the destination it copies from the end backwards so overlapping regions are preserved, otherwise it copies forwards from the start.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:130C
name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of allocated nodes from the head pointer in the context block, releasing each node through the memory-free library call. It then clears the head pointer and the node count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:133C
name: lookup_entry_and_call_handler
description: Looks up an entry with the first routine and returns a failure result if none is found. Otherwise it calls the second routine with the entry's stored pointer and the remaining arguments, and returns a failure result if the global error flag is set.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:138C
name: allocate_and_append_list_node
description: Allocates a node through the memory-allocation library call and, on success, stores a size field and links the node at the tail of a global list, setting the head pointer when the list was empty. It returns a pointer just past the node header, or zero on failure.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:13F8
name: allocate_from_free_list
description: Rounds the requested size up to an aligned minimum and searches the free list for the first block large enough, splitting it when it is bigger. If nothing fits it allocates a new chunk, returns it to the free list, and retries; it returns a null pointer when allocation fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:14BC
name: transfer_flagged_entries
description: Walks the entry list and, for each entry whose second flag bit is set and third flag bit is clear with a non-zero gap between two of its fields, passes the entry's address and that length to a transfer routine. It finally calls a completion routine with its argument.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1510
name: write_with_error_status
description: Clears the error field, calls a routine first when the pending flag is set, and performs the DOS write call through the library pointer. When the write returns minus one it stores the error code and sets a status value, then returns the write result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:155C
name: uppercase_first_char_after_calls
description: Returns zero when a stack-limit guard fails. Otherwise it places a constant address and a fixed length into a stack frame, calls a routine twice, and converts the first byte of the value read back to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1564
name: seek_and_adjust_position
description: Clears the error field, calls a routine first when the pending flag is set, and performs the DOS seek call. On failure it records the error code and sets a status value; for mode one it adds the seek result to the offset, and for mode two it seeks again to report the current position.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:15D8
name: read_with_error_status
description: Clears the error field, calls a routine first when the pending flag is set, and performs the DOS read call through the library pointer. When the read returns minus one it stores the error code and sets a status value, then returns the read count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1624
name: open_file_with_error_capture
description: Clears the error field, calls a routine first when the pending flag is set, and runs the DOS open call through the library pointer. When no handle is returned it stores the error code, sets a status value, and returns a failure result; otherwise it returns the handle.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:166C
name: release_signal_port_and_memory
description: When the pointer field at the structure's offset ten is set, it removes a message port through the library call. It then marks two fields unused with minus-one values, releases a signal, and frees the memory through the memory-free library call.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:16AC
name: reset_fields_and_free_memory
description: Writes minus-one markers into a status byte and two long fields of the structure, then releases the structure's memory through the memory-free library call.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:16DC
name: close_file_handle
description: When the pending flag is set it calls a routine first. It then closes the file through the DOS close call and returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1700
name: open_library_and_call_setup
description: Opens a library through the exec library call and calls an error routine with a fixed code if that fails. It copies the length-prefixed name string from the context into a local buffer, null-terminates it, and passes it with the library handle and fixed values to a setup routine, then calls the error routine again.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:17B4
name: multiply_longwords_truncated
description: Multiplies two 32-bit operands from the data registers using 16-bit partial products, adding the cross terms to the shifted low-word product, and returns the low 32 bits of the result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:17D4
name: divide_signed_longwords
description: Divides a signed 32-bit dividend by a divisor. A negative dividend is handled by dividing its magnitude through the unsigned division routine and negating the quotient, and a negative divisor is passed to that routine directly. Otherwise it normalizes the divisor and estimates and corrects the quotient in 16-bit steps.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1806
name: divide_unsigned_with_remainder
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by a divisor and returns the quotient and remainder as one pair. A divisor with a zero high word uses two 16-bit divide steps; otherwise the divisor is normalized and the quotient is estimated and corrected.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1898
name: create_signal_and_message_port
description: Allocates a signal and then a port structure, releasing the signal if the port allocation fails. It records the owning task, stores the signal number, and a type and priority, then either initializes an empty message list when the first argument is zero or adds the port through the library call.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1928
name: allocate_typed_structure_block
description: When the size argument is nonzero, allocates a block through the memory-allocation library call and fills in a type value, a flag byte cleared to zero, the pointer argument, and a word value. It returns the block, or zero when the size is zero or allocation fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1970
name: lookup_table_entry_by_index
description: Clears the error field, then checks the index against the table count and confirms that the table slot is not empty. An invalid or empty slot records an error code and returns zero; otherwise it returns the address of that slot.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:0288

name: send_command_request_one_length
description: Sets the request block's length field to one and its command field to nine, submits the request through the device routine, and returns its result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:02D2
name: read_track_block_request
description: Sets the request's command to two and its length to a fixed block size, with the data pointer taken from the buffer argument and the offset set to the track index times that block size. It submits the request and returns whether its error byte is zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:0320
name: submit_track_block_command
description: Builds a request with the same layout as the track read routine but with command eleven, submits it through the device routine, and returns whether the request reported no error.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:036E
name: send_command_return_actual
description: Sets the request block's command field to a fixed value, submits the request through the device routine, and returns the actual-count field of the request.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:0392
name: copy_disk_into_track_buffers
description: Opens the trackdisk device through a message port and request block, prompts for the source and destination disks in turn, and copies the disk by reading every track into its own allocated buffer and then writing the buffers out. It reports port, device, read and write failures with messages, frees the buffers and closes the device.

name: copy_disk_through_single_buffer
description: Opens the trackdisk device, allocates one track-sized buffer, and prompts for the source and destination disks. It reads each track into the buffer and writes it out, shows a working message, then frees the buffer and closes the device.

description: Calls the exec library's message-put routine through the library base held in a global. The caller sets up the arguments, so this routine only forwards the call.

description: Calls the exec library's I/O request routine through the library base held in a global, passing along the request block set up by the caller.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:0974

description: Calls the exec library routine that waits for an I/O request to finish, through the library base held in a global.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:097A
name: find_current_task
description: Calls the exec library routine that locates a task, through the library base held in a global, and returns its result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:0980
name: free_memory_block
description: Calls the exec library's memory-free routine through the library base held in a global.

name: get_message_from_port
description: Calls the exec library routine that takes the next message from a port, through the library base held in a global.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:2:098C

description: Calls the exec library routine that closes an I/O device, through the library base held in a global.

description: When the pointer field at the structure's offset ten is set, it removes a message port through the library call. It then marks two fields unused with minus-one values, releases a signal, and frees the memory through the memory-free library call.

name: open_io_device
description: Calls the exec library routine that opens an I/O device, through the library base held in a global, and returns its result.

description: Calls one library routine through a base pointer stored at a fixed memory address, with the arguments left in place by the caller.

description: Writes minus-one markers into a status byte and two long fields of the structure, then releases the structure's memory through the memory-free library call.

description: Scans the zero-terminated text argument to its end, then performs the DOS write call, and performs it again when the flag argument is nonzero. It returns the result of the last write.

name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls the memory-allocation library routine through the library base held in a global and returns the block it provides.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:1:067A

description: For each stored entry, formats a numbered label into a buffer and prints it. It then copies the name held in that entry's five-byte slot after the label and prints that too, returning the last print result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:1:0858

description: Forbids task switching while it walks a system list of named entries, comparing each name against a copied string and recording the names that pass into the five-byte table. It stores the count of recorded names, permits task switching again, and returns the permit result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:1:098E
name: print_copier_title_banner
description: Sets four characters of a context text field to ASCII zero, then prints a banner with a title line and credit lines, separated by blank lines, through the DOS write routine.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:1:0A96
name: call_context_field_then_zero
description: When the stack-limit check fails, it calls a routine with the first context field, then calls another routine with zero and returns that result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:1:0AB0

description: Scans the zero-terminated text argument to its end, then performs the DOS write call, and performs it again when the flag argument is nonzero. It returns the result of the last write.

name: poll_until_nonzero_byte
description: Calls a routine in a loop until the low byte of its result is nonzero, then returns that byte.
